push.title: W 3-0 vs Jebem Ti Kruha | You: 7.4 (above average FOR)
push.body:
A 7.4, PhogsToffees. That's a sturdy front porch of a performance. We can build a house on it.

DID WELL
+ 3 shots at Jebem Ti Kruha's goal. Fortune favors the folks who shoot.
+ 3 of 3 shots on target. You made that keeper earn his paycheck.
+ 1 key pass. A good pass is a love note. You wrote a few.
+ A goal against Jebem Ti Kruha. Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it.
+ Man of the Match, your 6th for us. That's leadership you can't fake.

WORK ON
- 67% passing (2 of 3, down from your usual 75%). Simple fix: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.
- 0.5 below your usual. Shake it off like a wet dog.
- Goals per shot on target: 33%. You're in the neighborhood. The fancy houses start at 60%+.

Training-ground special: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it.

Go easy on yourself tonight. Go hard at it tomorrow. - Coach Lasso
